# Dux v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

DuckDB-native dataframe library for Elixir

## GUIDES

- [Changelog](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Guides
  - [Getting Started](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/getting-started.md)
  - [Data IO](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/data-io.md)
  - [Transformations](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/transformations.md)
  - [Joins &amp; Reshape](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/joins-and-reshape.md)
  - [Distributed Execution](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/distributed.md)

- Cheatsheets
  - [Dux Cheatsheet](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/cheatsheet.md)

## Modules

- [Dux.FTS](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.FTS.md): Full-text search with BM25 scoring.
- [Dux.JSON](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.JSON.md): JSON processing verbs for semi-structured data.

- Core API
  - [Dux](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.md): DuckDB-native dataframe library for Elixir.
  - [Dux.Datasets](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Datasets.md): Embedded datasets for learning and testing.
  - [Dux.Query](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Query.md): Macro-based query expressions for Dux.

- Graph
  - [Dux.Graph](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Graph.md): Graph analytics on Dux dataframes.

- Distribution
  - [Dux.Remote](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Remote.md): Distributed query execution across BEAM nodes.
  - [Dux.Remote.Broadcast](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Remote.Broadcast.md): Broadcast join support for distributed queries.
  - [Dux.Remote.Coordinator](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Remote.Coordinator.md): Orchestrates distributed query execution across a cluster of Dux workers.
  - [Dux.Remote.Shuffle](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Remote.Shuffle.md): Distributed shuffle join for large-large joins.
  - [Dux.Remote.Worker](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Remote.Worker.md): A DuckDB worker node in a distributed Dux cluster.

- Integrations
  - [Dux.Flame](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Flame.md): Spin up Dux workers on FLAME runners for distributed queries.
  - [Dux.Telemetry](https://dux.hexdocs.pm/Dux.Telemetry.md): Telemetry events emitted by Dux.
